description: This file defines the DigitalProductService interface, which extends a generic entity service for managing DigitalProduct entities and provides methods related to saving, updating, and retrieving digital products associated with merchant stores and products.

classes.name: DigitalProductService
classes.description: An interface extending generic service operations specifically for DigitalProduct entities, including methods for saving/updating and retrieving digital products in relation to merchant stores and products.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new DigitalProduct or updates an existing one, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates an InputContentFile with a Product and DigitalProduct, enabling digital content management.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a specific MerchantStore and Product.
